faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: What to check before you start

items.question: What does the Pilot plan include?
items.answer: The Pilot plan at €29/Bulan includes up to 30 Karyawan, web and mobile time tracking, absences and leave, employee records and PDF Slip Gajis. Free 14-day trial, no credit card required.

items.question: Can I change plan later?
items.answer: Yes, anytime. Upgrades are instant, downgrades apply at the next cycle. No hidden fees.

items.question: How does Langganan & Tagihan work?
items.answer: Each plan includes a fixed Bulanly price with an included employee cap (30 for Pilot, 200 for Operations, unlimited for Enterprise). No per-Aktif-employee surcharge.

items.question: Is the trial really free?
items.answer: Yes. Full free trial — 30 days on the Free plan, 14 days on paid Paket Layanan. No credit card needed to sign up.

items.question: What happens when the trial ends?
items.answer: You choose a plan or your data stays archived for 14 more days. No automatic Langganan & Tagihan without your consent.

items.question: What support is available?
items.answer: Pilot: email support within 48h. Operations: Prioritas support within 24h. Enterprise: dedicated account manager + contractual SLA.

items.question: Where is my data hosted?
items.answer: In Europe (Render EU / Supabase EU). AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit. Tenant isolation guaranteed.

items.question: Are you GDPR compliant?
items.answer: Yes. DPA available, data exclusively in Europe, right to erasure implemented, data Ekspors on request.

items.question: Is the API available?
items.answer: REST API and webhooks are available from the Operations plan. On Pilot you can Ekspor your data as CSV/Excel.
